verdict.rationale: Monitoring booked travel rates and rebooking on price drops is a plausible feature for a business cards and spend platform, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions travel booking, rate monitoring, or automatic rebooking. The documented card features (virtual cards, spend limits, receipt matching, agent card credentials via the Vault API) are about cards and spending, not travel rates.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have booked travel rates automatically monitored and rebooked when prices drop
